sources.title: Routing-Drift in MoE and Continual Learning
sources.snippet: Routing-Drift is an umbrella term for failures in mapping inputs to intended experts, arising from sequential updates, distribution shifts, and hardware degradation. It manifests as phenomena like semantic drift, misaligned co-drift, and safety routing drift across lifelong editing, MoE-LoRA tuning, and token-level routing.
